verdict: key consistent: 79 legible signs + 3 under the stain = 82 letters of the cipher's text, 21 groups = 21 words, one letter per shape; homophones ر (S1, S15), ب (S7, S19), ك (S14, S16). The plaintext is the well-known pair رهنت يدي بالعجز ... / ولو كان مما يستطاع ..., with three words different from the record
notes: Rows 2r l.4-9 on image 0084_0008. Signs per row 15,13,14(+3 illegible),14,13,10 = 79 legible (record 15,16,16,15,14,9 = 85; the segmenter split signs on row 5 and missed the ي at the right end of row 9, outside its box); dividers 4,4,4,3,4,2 = 21 (record 18). Row 6: a white stain covers the ر ي of شكري (about 100 px between S14 and the divider, whose two lower dots survive) and the first ل of للشكور (one stroke visible); keyed as missing letters, not encipherer's drops. Row 7: the two م of مما are under the same stain, but the crown-and-foot remains of S17 are visible for both. Record errors: (1) the second verse begins ولو كان مما (two م signs + K), not ولو كان ما; (2) the first verse ends وما بعد شكري للشكور مزيد: groups S19 S10 S6 (?, ع, د: بعد; S10 is ع in بالعجز, عن, يستطاع, استطعته; S6 is د in يدي, مزيد, شديد), S13 S14 + 2 = شكري, ? S9 S13 S14 S18 S1 = للشكور (6 signs, not للمشكور 7), S17 S12 S5 S6 = مزيد; مزيد is the small word the record notes above l.14, which belongs to the verse, not a gloss. The well-known form is وما فوق شكري للشكور مزيد; the cipher has ?عد (S19 is a singleton, ب taken from بعد). (3) بره is 4 signs S7 S15 S16 S17 = ب ر ك م (S16 is ك in ولكن; S17 م in وما, مزيد, مما, ما): بركم. The page's 'بدلت' is not in the cipher. The heading on l.3 (بيتين ... ايضا للمخزومي, 'two verses, also by al-Makhzumi') introduces the block, so the record's doubt that l.13-14 answer it can be dropped: the cipher spells the two verses. The record's answered 'partial' should be 'yes'.
